mathematical_statement: Candidate index set is finite and nonempty
implementation_correspondence: locking._validate_candidates rejects an empty sequence; Python sequences are finite in the exercised API
limitations: Resource exhaustion for extremely large finite inputs is outside the theorem

implementation_correspondence: locking._validate_candidates rejects empty masks and duplicate feature names
limitations: The public jaccard helper retains a both-empty convention, but validated locking candidates cannot be empty

implementation_correspondence: locking._validate_candidates applies numpy.isfinite; fold vectors are also validated when present
limitations: Floating-point arithmetic is deterministic only for the same software/platform inputs

implementation_correspondence: LockingConfig.metric_orientation must equal larger_is_better; the scoring helper whitelists larger-is-better classification scores
limitations: Users supplying transformed custom scores remain responsible for semantic correctness
Best-run-SE-scaled thresholds additionally require valid fold scores

mathematical_statement: All masks share one ordered feature universe
implementation_correspondence: candidate_universe is validated across records; pipeline scoring copies the ordered development columns into every candidate
limitations: When no universe is supplied, the direct API derives a sorted union and records it

mathematical_statement: Feature order cannot change the mask or digest
implementation_correspondence: locking canonicalizes against the common universe and calls the authoritative genetic_rf._stable_mask_hash SHA-256 rule
limitations: SHA-256 collision resistance is an engineering assumption; observed unequal-mask collisions are rejected

implementation_correspondence: The maximum score is computed over a validated nonempty bank; a runtime guard rejects an unexpected empty pool
limitations: The mathematical proof, not the runtime guard, establishes the property

implementation_correspondence: Absolute and relative eligibility use exact comparisons without epsilon expansion; selection never leaves the pool and a postcondition is checked
limitations: The guarantee concerns the supplied empirical scores only

mathematical_statement: At delta=0 the pool is exactly the score maximizers
implementation_correspondence: Zero-tolerance pool formation uses exact zero regret; singleton and tied-medoid paths are separate
limitations: Existing source tables happened to have singleton delta-zero pools; that is empirical, not universal

mathematical_statement: Large delta yields the full-bank medoid
implementation_correspondence: Every candidate passing the threshold enters the same medoid calculation
limitations: No claim is made that the full-bank medoid has small regret

mathematical_statement: Selection and complete audit are deterministic
implementation_correspondence: Canonical masks, stable hashes, canonical row ordering, key-sorted JSON, and provenance normalization remove input-row dependence
limitations: Complete audit identity presumes unchanged source-provenance fields and environment-level floating serialization

mathematical_statement: Candidate-record permutations preserve the selected feature set
implementation_correspondence: Scientific tie keys contain no row position; audit tables are emitted in stable hash/provenance order
limitations: Adding or removing a duplicate changes the multiset and is not a permutation

mathematical_statement: Duplicate masks remain multiple voting candidates
implementation_correspondence: No deduplication occurs; audit records multiplicity and all source records carrying the selected mask
limitations: Lowest source run ID is used only to label one provenance record after feature-set selection

mathematical_statement: Highest-score, full-medoid, top-k, and regret-medoid rules have different guarantees
implementation_correspondence: Package exposes legacy top_k_jaccard_medoid and upgraded regret_constrained_medoid as separate strategies
status: proved and tested for strategy separation
limitations: No strategy is claimed to solve globally optimal feature selection

implementation_correspondence: Candidate audit, pairwise table, selected features, and metadata are serializable through CSV/JSON/NPY artifact paths
limitations: CSV type inference may not preserve every pandas dtype exactly; scientific values and identifiers are preserved
